title: Decision: AES SETKEY returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE to let wolfSSL run the software key schedule
description: crypto2dev_aes_setkey_ctx():L559-567. After storing the key in aes->devCtx, the function returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE instead of 0. This is intentional: it causes wolfSSL to also run the software key schedule (setting aes->rounds, computing the GCM H-subkey). Without this, wc_AesGcmSetKey callers get KEYUSAGE_E at the first encrypt because aes->rounds == 0. The hardware cipher path (crypto2dev_cipher) checks devCtx first and uses hardware regardless of what the software schedule set. A contributor who changes this to return 0 to 'claim the key' will break GCM without a clear error.
